fees.name: Title - Settlement Agent Fee (Shopped - Selected from List)
Title - Lender's Title Insurance (Shopped - Selected from List)

computation: 1. Zero-Tolerance Check: LE = $500.00, CD = $500.00. Variance = $0.00. 2. 10% Aggregate Bucket Check: LE Sum = $1000.00 + $800.00 + $200.00 = $2000.00. Maximum Allowable Threshold (LE Sum * 1.10) = $2200.00. CD Sum = $1200.00 + $650.00 + $220.00 = $2070.00. Note on aggregate rule: Settlement agent fee increased by $200.00, but Title Insurance decreased by $150.00 and Recording increased by $20.00. Under §1026.19(e)(3)(ii), we compare total CD ($2070.00) against total LE ($2000.00), resulting in an aggregate increase of $70.00 (+3.5%), NOT the sum of increases ($220.00 or +11.0%). Since $2070.00 <= $2200.00, there is no violation. 3. No Limit Bucket: Prepaid insurance chosen by borrower, excluded from tolerance calculation.
clause_basis: 12 CFR §1026.19(e)(3)(i) for zero tolerance, 12 CFR §1026.19(e)(3)(ii) for 10% aggregate tolerance, and 12 CFR §1026.19(e)(3)(iii) for unlimited tolerance.
weakest_point: Assumes the consumer was permitted to shop for title services and selected a provider from the lender's written list of service providers.

fees.name: Title - Abstract Fee (Shopped - Selected from List)
Title - Examination Fee (Shopped - Selected from List)

computation: 1. Zero-Tolerance Check: LE = $1500.00, CD = $1500.00. Variance = $0.00. 2. 10% Aggregate Bucket Check: LE Sum = $400.00 + $500.00 + $100.00 = $1000.00. Maximum Allowable Threshold (LE Sum * 1.10) = $1100.00. CD Sum = $600.00 + $350.00 + $180.00 = $1130.00. Aggregate Comparison: Total CD ($1130.00) exceeds maximum allowable ($1100.00) by $30.00. (Note: Incorrect sum-of-increases logic would yield ($200 + $80) = $280 increase, overestimating cure as $180; the correct aggregate method netting the $150 decrease yields a $30.00 excess).
violations: 10% Aggregate Bucket violated by $30.00. Lender cure required: $30.00 refund to borrower.
clause_basis: 12 CFR §1026.19(e)(3)(ii) and cure provisions under 12 CFR §1026.19(f)(2)(v).
weakest_point: Ensuring proper characterization of recording fees under the 10% category.

case_name: Zero-Tolerance Violation with Mixed Bucket Types
computation: 1. Zero-Tolerance Check: Credit Report LE = $30.00, CD = $45.00 (Excess = $15.00). Transfer Taxes LE = $1200.00, CD = $1250.00 (Excess = $50.00). Total Zero-Tolerance Cure = $15.00 + $50.00 = $65.00. 2. 10% Aggregate Bucket Check: LE Sum = $150.00. Maximum Allowable Threshold = $165.00. CD Sum = $160.00. Since $160.00 <= $165.00, 10% bucket is compliant. 3. No Limit Bucket: Escrow deposit excluded.
violations: Zero-tolerance bucket violated by $65.00 ($15.00 on Credit Report + $50.00 on Transfer Taxes). Cure amount = $65.00.
weakest_point: Categorization of Transfer Taxes as zero tolerance relies on absence of changed circumstances.

case_name: Shopped Off-List Reassignment to No Limit
computation: 1. 10% Aggregate Bucket Check: LE Sum = $150.00. Max Allowable = $165.00. CD Sum = $160.00. Compliant. 2. No Limit Bucket Check: Title Closing Fee was shopped and borrower selected a provider NOT on lender's written list. Thus, service moves from 10% aggregate to no-limit per §1026.19(e)(3)(iii)(A). Increased amount ($950.00 vs $700.00) is permitted.
clause_basis: 12 CFR §1026.19(e)(3)(iii)(A) for services permitted to shop where borrower selects off-list provider.
weakest_point: Fact-dependent determination that borrower selected provider independently off the written list.
